extracted.name: Pimento Cheese Dip
extracted.description: This easy homemade Pimento Cheese Dip recipe is creamy, tangy, and packed with flavor from sharp cheddar and sweet pimentos. It takes 5 minutes and can be served hot or cold as the perfect appetizer, dip, or sandwich spread!
ingredient_lines: 3 Tablespoons chopped pimentos (, from a jar)
Crackers and cold veggies for serving
instruction_lines: Mix: Use a hand mixer or food processor to mix all ingredients until well combined, and almost smooth.
Serve cold with crackers, vegetables, or spread on a sandwich or burger.
Or Serve Hot: For hot pimento cheese dip, spread pimento cheese into a small baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes, or until hot.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to one week.
categories: How to make pimento cheese dip
